title: Barbershop
description:
S1 E1
Calvin, who inherited a struggling barbershop, views the shop as nothing but a burden and waste of his time. After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy .

title: Barbershop 2: Back in Business
description:
S1 E1 — Barbershop 2: Back in Business (2004)
The Barbershop is threatened by the arrival of a hip, well-financed chain barbershop that's about to open next door.

title: Barbershop: The Next Cut
description:
S1 E1
It's been more than 10 years since our last appointment at Calvin's Barbershop. Ice Cube, Cedric the Entertainer and the whole crew are back together for a quick trim, some good conversation, a little gossip...and to save their neighborhood!

title: Albany Road
description:
S1 E1
On her way to the most important meeting of her career, a New York executive is forced to share a rental car with her ex-fiancé's mother, only to discover that the mother is hiding a major secret.
